comment: dev.28 15a: the game's own kick of a machine (docs/re/network.md, 'Ending a machine'). SessionKickMachine(session, machine handle, ban) queues session command 3; the session thread sends the machine the session's kick message and, a second later, removes its online peer the way a timed-out peer is removed (Steam CloseConnection). The game calls it from the GameServer thread for an admin's kick (ban 0) and ban (ban 1), with the session at GameServer+0x10. kiln.net calls it with ban 0, only when the login failure cannot be sent to a refused peer.

@net.session_kick_command.comment: the command it queues: type 3 (kick machine), then the queue's count of commands sent

@net.account_kick.comment: the game's own callers (account actions, GameServer thread): kick = ban 0 unless the record's flag bit 0 is set, ban = ban 1; the machine handle is the player record's peer (gs.records + rec.peer)

net/gs.session.comment: GameServer -> the session (the same object as the socket set's first word)
